section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the impact of training goals, contrasting traditional performance goals with mastery goals. It argues that performance goals may hinder learning for complex tasks by limiting cognitive resources and promoting superficial learning, while mastery goals are hypothesized to be more effective for complex skill acquisition by focusing on deeper concepts and fostering self-efficacy and coherent knowledge structures. The text does not describe any specific empirical studies conducted by the authors.
